「Then we don't have time to argue about being outsiders!」

587:t_003:49.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「The dimensional boundary is warping again!」

587:t_004:0.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Are those the pitch-black bastards we saw in that weird universe?!」

587:t_004:1.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Their numbers aren't the same as last time!」

587:t_004:2.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Did $$サイデリアル$$ follow us here?!」

587:t_005:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$アクシズ$$ is accelerating!」

587:t_005:1.en:
$$アポロ$$
「They're trying to drop $$アクシズ$$?!」

587:t_005:2.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Was $$サイデリアル$$'s intervention what brought about the $$黒歴史$$...?!」

587:t_005:4.en:
$$ノノ$$
「We can't just stand by and let this happen!」

587:t_005:5.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「They're outsiders who came through a $$時空震動$$, too. You have no objection to stopping them, $$シャア$$?」

587:t_005:7.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Let's do this, everyone...! Don't let the black $$アンゲロイ$$s interfere in this battle!」

587:t_005:9.en:
$$葵$$
「But... why did they come to this world to drop $$アクシズ$$...?」

587:t_005:10.en:
$$刹那$$
「Don't expect an answer... They reject us completely.」

587:t_005:11.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「They seek to crush our hearts with terror...」

587:t_005:12.en:
$$キリコ$$
「They are the future of despair...」

587:t_005:13.en:
$$シャア$$
「So they are the fundamental calamity.」

587:t_005:15.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I will present the combat analysis. Our probability of victory is...」

587:t_005:16.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「We don't need to hear it.」

587:t_005:17.en:
$$宗介$$
「We have no choice but to win!」

587:t_005:18.en:
$$甲児$$
「We already stopped $$アクシズ$$ from falling once! Like hell we'll let them do it right in front of us!」

587:t_005:19.en:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, begin your attack! Forget about $$アクシズ$$ for now! Focus on the black $$アンゲロイ$$s!」

587:t_005:20.en:
$$セツコ$$
「They are the fundamental calamity... They stand in the way of humanity's future...」

587:t_005:21.en:
$$ランド$$
「Now I get it. They're... the enemy of every living thing!」

587:t_005:22.en:
$$シャア$$
「Humanity cannot submit to their existence...! And neither can I!」

587:t_006:0.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「We managed to win, but...」

587:t_006:1.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Damn...! Our attacks barely scratch them...」

587:t_006:2.en:
$n
「Is this... $$サイデリアル$$'s true power...?」

587:t_006:4.en:
$$レド$$
「Their main forces are indeed at the center of the galaxy. But even $$チェインバー#pilot$$ had no data on those black $$アンゲロイ$$s.」

587:t_006:5.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Are they unrelated to $$サイデリアル$$?」

587:t_006:6.en:
$$オズマ$$
「That's possible, since they weren't deployed at $$ラース・バビロン$$, the Emperor's stronghold.」

$$カミーユ$$
「Those bastards...! Are they planning to finish the job?!」

587:t_009:1.en:
$$シャア$$
「I don't know what my counterpart in this world was thinking when he tried to drop $$アクシズ$$.」

587:t_009:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「Perhaps, like me, he believed you would stop him.」

587:t_010:0.en:
$$シャア$$
(My counterpart in this world... If you are dropping $$アクシズ$$ out of conviction, I have nothing to say.)

587:t_010:1.en:
$$シャア$$
(And this is strictly a battle between you and $$アムロ$$'s group. I will eliminate the interfering $$サイデリアル$$...!)

587:t_010:2.en:
$$アムロ$$
「The enemy is distracted by $$シャア$$!」

587:t_010:4.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「We can't let you die here!!」

587:t_011:1.en:
$$ロラン$$
「That will stop $$アクシズ$$ from accelerating!」

587:t_011:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「This, too, is the result of your risking your life.」

587:t_011:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「You don't need to feel any misplaced responsibility. This is already a parallel world separate from our own.」

587:t_012:1.en:
$$カレン$$
「Are we really... just going to watch how this battle turns out...?」

587:t_012:2.en:
$$桂$$

587:t_013:1.en:
$$桂$$

587:t_013:2.en:

587:t_013:3.en:

587:t_013:4.en:

587:t_013:5.en:
$$シャア$$
「I'm sorry I dragged you into my doubts.」

587:t_013:6.en:

587:t_013:8.en:

587:t_013:10.en:
